title: AFP Forum cyberattack, Nov 2026

subject.name: AFP
subject.about: Agence France-Presse (AFP) is one of the world's three global news agencies, with AP and Reuters. It employs about 1,840 journalists in 210 bureaus and supplies news organisations with text, photos and video in six languages.

disclaimer: Made for entertainment using AI. Not endorsed by Agence France-Presse, any news outlet, company, or anyone else named.
size_basis: A cyberattack took offline the platform that news organisations use to get content from AFP, one of the three global news agencies. AFP has not said that any other system was hit or that any data was taken.
who_is_affected: AFP's subscribers, mostly news organisations, which use AFP Forum to find and download AFP's stories, photos and videos. AFP says it is offering them other ways to get its content while the platform is offline. It has not said whether any data was taken.

known.text: AFP says a cyberattack hit AFP Forum, a platform its clients use, starting at 1:30 am Paris time on Nov 26.
AFP took AFP Forum offline when it found the intrusion, and the platform is still unavailable.
AFP is investigating with outside experts and says it does not know who was behind the attack.

not_known.text: When AFP Forum will be back.
